hostLifecycleContract.hostPatchVerification: The profile-level runtime packages were installed into the daily desktop profile without touching app.asar or native components. Daily HTTP/storage verification covered ordinary and archived deletion (200, tombstoned), unconfirmed 400, real running-turn 409, and move to Crodis with real bash pwd plus reverse/forward moves; all 70 pre-existing sessions stayed intact. After finding that a tag-built controller dropped newer session/events, session/state and throughSeq-optional page behavior, the controller was rebuilt as a thin subclass of the installed controller that only adds lifecycle methods; isolated verification preserves events/page/state/wait, manages fork children, releases idle Agents, refuses running turns, and restores replaced methods on dispose. The client-safe controller/decorator profile was applied and the daily Electron UI was verified; the user then manually verified native drag move and Codex confirmed the result via RPC.
hostLifecycleContract.clientRegistration: The official session-controller row remains enabled; its dsh.client module registers ClientSessions and provides the browser sessions service. Daily Electron main UI, workspaces/session list and model selector were verified after the client registration fix.
hostLifecycleContract.dailyState: Daily profile currently still has the old backend-only layer (session-controller row disabled); the client-safe narrow profile edit and decorator are staged but not applied. The script validates and changes only two SB fragments, never replaces the full user profile, and stores no full profile snapshot in the repo. The previously retained temporary session was cleaned by Codex; session/list is 70. Codex will apply with the desktop stopped, restart, and verify the Electron main UI, sessions list/model selector, GET support and events/page/state/wait.
